findings.text: the sup_where guard that stops the measurement aborting on an empty shadow selection (commit 9d62c8f4c) has no dedicated regression test; tests/test_zero_residual_render.py is receipt-driven and never re-executes _carrier_statistics, so a future regression that reintroduces an unguarded np.max over an empty shadow mask would only surface by someone rerunning the benchmark by hand. The pre-fix crash is preserved as evidence (receipt.aborted-run.stub.json, completed=false, rows={}, source_revision 0013758a7db8bee5c2fb1e02a3351b456efa839d, one commit before the guard) but nothing pins it going forward.

the landing comment discloses, correctly and without recaptioning, that the shadow census is now empty for both rows (9123/9123 and 9009/9009 entering) where the reviewed revision excluded 73 and 54, and that the unmasked supremum moved (1.1236->1.1000 Wb, 44.11->42.25 Wb); the repaired panel's residual story therefore differs from the one the cut-cell-current-attribution audit originally scored, and the comment says this in scope rather than folding it into the fix silently — flagged here only because it is new information a downstream reader of the audit score needs, not because the disclosure itself is a defect.

justifications.durability: tests/test_zero_residual_render.py carries no slow marker so it is collected by the default lane, asserts the render receipt's stated levels actually cross each panel's own raster range (guarding the union-vs-per-raster regression this node exists to fix), and its declared negative control was reproduced independently in this review (rerunning the test file's __main__ block gave the identical AssertionError '0 vs 8'). The separate crash the node fixed en route (sup_where over an empty shadow selection) is documented with a preserved pre-fix stub receipt but has no standing regression test, so that guard could silently regress; docked for that gap alone.
justifications.evidence: independently reran tests/test_zero_residual_render.py in the target worktree (1 passed, matches manifest) and its negative-control __main__ block (AssertionError 'stated levels do not match the counted levels inside the raster (0 vs 8)', byte-identical to the recorded negative_control.log). Opened zero-residual-map.png with the image tool: all four panel titles carry residual= and converged=, both terminal-flux panels draw nonzero unfilled contour lines with the wall and both solved/reference axis markers (no X-points in either case, matching null_glyphs=0 x_points in the receipt), no axes or gridlines. render-receipt.json's per-panel level_count/levels_inside_raster/null_glyphs match the image exactly. render_only.log shows the render-only entry point produced all four panel records in 20.8 s (receipt-only, no solve). The pre-fix crash (unguarded np.max on an empty shadow selection) is corroborated by receipt.aborted-run.stub.json (completed=false, rows={}) at the commit before the guard landed.
justifications.fit: reuses the established nova.media.poloidal painters (draw_flux_contours, draw_wall, draw_nulls) unchanged in call shape; the one new abstraction, _resolve_levels, is a small per-raster helper that replaces a shared union-level computation with the same poloidal.contour_levels call applied per row, which is the minimal fix for the diagnosed defect (a level array computed over the concatenation of two rasters differing in span by ~36x). No plan/stage labels, no versioned filenames, no author attribution in code or comments.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the driving goal (terminal flux panel draws unfilled contours on stated levels from the persisted state with both null sets, wall, residual= and converged= in the title, or a caption naming the missing receipt) is met and verified directly: the moderate-rotation-conventional-static panel that was previously empty now draws 8 of its 10 stated levels inside its own raster range, both null sets are drawn and counted, and the title carries residual=2.011e-03 converged=False. The node additionally repaired a crash that was silently overwriting the acceptance receipt with an empty stub before any row could render, which was necessary to produce the persisted raster this goal depends on, and disclosed rather than hid the resulting change in the residual story.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff main...HEAD touches exactly benchmarks/zero_residual_check.py, tests/test_zero_residual_render.py, docs/plans/figure-and-solver-audit.html, docs/evidence/archive/figure-and-solver-audit-landed.html, and files under docs/figures/cut-cell-current-attribution/zero-residual/ (receipt.json, render-receipt.json, panels/, parts/) — all within the declared fence. The worker correctly did not resolve its own driving followup f-cca-repair-empty-terminal-flux-panel or set a plan-level terminal status, leaving that to the coordinator per the who-closes-the-node contract, and reported the residual-story change and the bookend-review requirement under follow_ons rather than adjudicating them itself.
